steps.instruction: Seed TMD8 cells at appropriate density in growth medium, prepare compound dilution series and vehicle controls.
Add compound dilutions to seeded cells and incubate.
Add CellTiter-Glo reagent, mix, stabilize, measure luminescence.
Normalize luminescence to vehicle control (100%) and background (no cells), fit a four‑parameter logistic curve, report EC50/IC50 with confidence intervals.

controls: positive control (known cytotoxic agent if available)
rationale: ATP‑based luminescence reports viable cell number, suitable for measuring growth/proliferation effects of CHEMBL5188786 in TMD8 cells.
limitations: Concentration series and replicate numbers are assumptions due to lack of source‑specific guidance.
Cell viability readout does not prove that CHEMBL5188786 inhibits BTK; off‑target cytotoxicity or unrelated pathways could affect viability.
Assumes TMD8 cells express BTK and that BTK inhibition would impact proliferation; this link is not demonstrated.
